comparison.objective: Seat labware and identify a faulty nest, versus adjust and validate a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Plate placement, flatness diagnosis, removal, and peg insertion versus hex-tool alignment, collar tuning, locking, and cycle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Good plates seated and the failed nest reported by a peg versus two safe stops within physical operating limits and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: The objectives and diagnostic manipulations are unrelated beyond generic placement. No spec versions are present; the body lacks numeric seating and peg tolerances.
